name: Global X SuperIncome Preferred ETF
desc: The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index tracks the performance of the highest-yielding preferred securities listed in the United States, as determined by Solactive AG, the administrator of the underlying index (“Index Administrator”).
